title: COGS module UI, React Query integration, and dashboard/report KPIs

requirements.summary: Replace the static /cogs page with a functional COGS module UI for managing items, purchases, sales, and viewing COGS summary/trends.
acceptanceCriteria: /cogs no longer shows a coming-soon alert by default; it provides working UI for: Items, Purchases, Sales, and Summary/Trends.
Users can create/edit/delete items, purchases, and sales from the UI using dialogs/forms consistent with existing CRUD patterns in the app.
Vendor selection is available where applicable and is populated from existing vendors master data.
The page shows total COGS for a selected time window and a simple trend visualization (e.g., table or lightweight chart) using the backend trend endpoint.
All user-facing text on the COGS page is in English.

file_operations.description: Replace the current coming-soon content with a tabbed COGS module UI (Items, Purchases, Sales, Summary/Trends). Use existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Tabs, Card, Table, Dialog, Button, Input, Select, ScrollArea, Alert) to match existing CRUD page patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Items management tab: list items, show empty/loading states, and provide create/edit/delete dialogs with fields for name, default unit cost, and optional vendor selection (populated via existing vendor master data). Use shadcn-ui Table + Dialog patterns consistent with Expenses/Revenue pages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Purchases tab: list purchases and provide create/edit/delete dialogs with date, item selection, quantity purchased, unit cost, and optional vendor selection. Reuse existing UI patterns (Table, Dialog, Select, Input) and show clear empty/loading states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Sales tab: list sales and provide create/edit/delete dialogs with date, item selection, and quantity sold. Reuse existing UI patterns (Table, Dialog, Select, Input) and show clear empty/loading states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the Summary/Trends tab: include a time window selector for COGS reporting, display computed total COGS for the selected window, and render a simple monthly trend visualization (table is acceptable) from trend query data. Use existing shadcn-ui components (Card, Table, Alert) and English text only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add small COGS UI utilities (e.g., mapping item/vendor IDs to display names, converting date inputs to backend Time BigInt) to keep tab components concise and consistent. Keep logic frontend-only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Extend the React Query data layer to support COGS items/purchases/sales CRUD plus total and trend queries, with proper invalidation/refresh behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: New hooks exist in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for listing and mutating COGS items, purchases, and sales, matching the patterns used for expenses and revenue.
After create/update/delete of COGS records, the COGS summary/trend queries and the dashboard query data are invalidated/refetched so UI stays consistent.
Loading and empty states are handled similarly to existing pages (spinner during load, clear empty-state messaging).

file_operations.description: Add COGS query/mutation hooks in this file (per acceptance criteria): queries for items/purchases/sales lists and for computed total COGS over a provided [start,end] window and monthly trend data; mutations for create/update/delete for items/purchases/sales. Ensure successful mutations invalidate/refetch relevant query keys (COGS lists, COGS total/trends, and dashboard). Keep patterns consistent with existing useExpenses/useRevenue hooks and handle actor dependency similarly.

Wire the new COGS hooks into the COGS module UI so screens refresh after mutations and show spinner/empty-state messaging consistent with existing pages. Use existing shadcn-ui components for alerts/loading/empty states where needed. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Integrate computed COGS into the dashboard KPIs and reports (including print views) and incorporate COGS into net profit calculations.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard KPI 'COGS' displays the computed COGS for the selected time window instead of the current placeholder value.
Reports include a displayed COGS total for the selected report range, and net profit calculations incorporate COGS (i.e., net profit = revenue - expenses - COGS) in the report summary section.
Report output remains printable using the existing print flow.

file_operations.description: Update useDashboardData to incorporate computed COGS for the selected time window (use the backend-provided COGS calculation capability via the actor) and adjust derived net profit/profit margin calculations accordingly. Ensure the dashboard query key and invalidations align with COGS mutations so KPI values stay current.

Display the dashboard 'COGS' KPI using the computed value from the dashboard data hook (remove placeholder behavior) and ensure any accompanying summary sections show the same computed COGS consistently. Use English text only.

Fetch computed COGS for the report date range and display a COGS total alongside revenue/expenses in the report summary. Update net profit calculation to: revenue - expenses - COGS, and ensure the printed output reflects the same values while keeping the existing print flow intact (no-print/print sections). Use existing shadcn-ui components and English text only. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
